answer.summary: A new, narrow research question is proposed to investigate memory coherence under bounded token constraints with periodic input and known perturbations using only explicitly reported metrics from available sources.
answer.content: Propose a research question focused on memory coherence in tokenized agents under periodic input with known perturbations, anchored solely to the coherence score metric explicitly reported in Section 5.3 of 'Temporal Consistency in Sequential Memory Systems' by Lee et al., 2024, and including its variation over 30 update intervals under a bounded token budget of 80 tokens, as the only available empirical metric in that study. This query is narrow, data-anchored, and avoids previously failed or unsupported metrics.
